When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

A reliable month-by-month ranking is not established in this edition. No “best month” score has been invented.

The decision that shapes this trip

Agree on an Arno-specific transfer and fishing program rather than assuming the standard Majuro departure reaches it. Keep target fish unresolved until the operator confirms whether the plan is lagoon, reef or bluewater fishing.

Build around a confirmed boat plan

Ask the crew to identify the primary target and method, the actual time spent fishing and how anglers share the available positions. Confirm the tackle that is supplied before buying rods or terminal gear. Keep spare clothing and electronics protected from spray.
